containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
echo "===I2862_START env=prod host=$(hostname) utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache curl gzip >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1; echo "apk_rc=$?"

doc_gz(){
  t=$1; lab=$2; p=$3
  B=/tmp/d.$$
  code=$(curl -s -m 60 -o "$B" -w '%{http_code}|%{size_download}|%{content_type}' "http://$t$p" 2>/dev/null); rc=$?
  echo "DOCGZ [$lab] $p rc=$rc -> $code"
  echo "-----BEGIN_B64 $lab $p-----"
  gzip -9 -c "$B" 2>/dev/null | base64 | tr -d '\n'
  echo ""
  echo "-----END_B64 $lab $p-----"
  rm -f "$B"
}
probe(){
  t=$1; lab=$2; shift 2
  for spec in "$@"; do
    B=/tmp/b.$$
    # spec format: path|||header1;header2   (headers may be empty)
    p=${spec%%|||*}
    hdr=${spec#*|||}
    if [ -n "$hdr" ]; then
      HS=""
      OLDIFS=$IFS; IFS=';'
      for h in $hdr; do HS="$HS -H $h"; done
      IFS=$OLDIFS
    else
      HS=""
    fi
    code=$(eval curl -s -m 10 -o "$B" -w "'%{http_code}|%{size_download}|%{content_type}'" $HS "http://$t$p" 2>/dev/null); rc=$?
    echo "HIT [$lab] $p hdr=[$hdr] rc=$rc -> $code :: $(head -c 400 "$B" 2>/dev/null | tr '\r\n' '  ')"
    rm -f "$B"
  done
}

doc_gz lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-data-c6480e54a84f2644.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com prod-elb-data /swagger/api-docs
probe lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-data-c6480e54a84f2644.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com prod-elb-data \
  '/dms/data-dashboard|||"Referer: admin"' \

probe lazamedical-prod01-usw2-notif-eafa1811fd6f6f78.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com prod-elb-notif \
